name: Toi
bio: Toi was the king of Hamath, a longtime rival of Hadadezer of Zobah. When Toi heard that David had defeated Hadadezer's entire army, he sent his son Joram (called Hadoram in 1 Chronicles 18:10) to greet David, congratulate him on the victory, and present him with vessels of silver, gold, and bronze, which David in turn dedicated to the LORD (2 Samuel 8:9-11).
